value.rationale: A complete, sharp, all-n, two-height static equilibrium signature classification for a canonical homogeneous polyhedral family; it gives three realized phases, two exactly located simultaneous n-point bifurcations, and the exact intermediate width sin(pi/n)^2 asymptotic pi^2/n^2. These conclusions are not textbook direct substitutions or consequences of the sources and provide a natural benchmark for the geometry of equilibrium changes under shape deformation. In particular, the complete family realizes the exact mechanical-complexity progression 0, 2n, 4n with a fixed polyhedral face vector.
